hero.headline: Where Certxa is headed.
hero.subhead: This is our public roadmap. We update it every sprint. Vote on features, track progress, and see what's shipping next.

items.title: Android Certxa app
items.description: Native Android companion app for staff and owners. Mirrors the iOS feature set.

items.title: Two-way SMS with clients
items.description: Reply to client messages directly from the Certxa dashboard. No third-party app needed.

items.title: Inventory management
items.description: Track retail product stock, set reorder thresholds, and generate purchase orders.

items.title: Gift cards
items.description: Sell and redeem digital and physical gift cards directly through Certxa POS.

items.title: Multi-location dashboard
items.description: Unified analytics and staff management across multiple salon locations.

items.title: Waitlist management
items.description: Let clients join a digital waitlist and get notified when a slot opens up.

items.title: Payroll integrations
items.description: Direct sync with Gusto and QuickBooks Payroll. No more manual exports.

items.title: Autumn AI receptionist
items.description: AI-powered after-hours booking and client communication.

items.title: Self check-in kiosk
items.description: Tablet-based kiosk with turn queue and service selection.

items.title: Points loyalty program
items.description: Earn points per dollar spent, redeemable for services.

items.title: Google review automation
items.description: Automated post-visit review request with smart timing.

cta.heading: Have a feature idea?
cta.subhead: We read every suggestion. Send us yours and it might make the next sprint.
